name: Chat:LiveHelperChat
description: Embeds a Live Helper Chat server's chat widget and FAQ into Drupal, with visibility rules.
project_description:
This module allows us to integrate open source chat Live Helper chat on our site. Two configuration options are allowed for them:

 
 Configure LiveHelperChat visually by administration, selecting the domain, height, size, subject ... of the chat. 
 Configure LiveHelperChat using JS script generated by chat server in https://demo.livehelperchat.com/site_admin/system/htmlcode#!#design . This script is embedded in the header of the page. 
 
 In addition, other chat visibility settings are established through the use of the Drupal conditions plugins Api:

 
 Visibility condition per page. 
 Visibility condition by user role. 
 Visibility condition by content type. 
 
 It allows administrators to inject JS into the page output according to configurable rules. It is useful to add the JS configuration generated in the Live Helper Chat server.
